summary: Completed backend regression and full frontend/admin retest for /ai-consulting single-page submission flow. Critical submit regression is fixed: live UI now sends JSON POST, keeps URL clean, shows exact success text, persists records, and renders new fields in admin modal/export.

integration_issues.issue: Final URL resolved to /admin login during unauthenticated/locked session checks, so runtime redirect-to-/admin/get-in-touch could not be conclusively re-verified in this pass.

action_items: Main agent to quickly self-verify /admin/project-enquiries redirect behavior with stable authenticated session (already defined in App route).
Optional UX refinement: for +44 search, default-first option may be Isle of Man; if UK should be preferred, add ranking preference rule.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend submit wiring fix is present and effective: useEnquiryForm.handleSubmit is bound to form onSubmit, no native GET/query leak observed.
Server-side and client-side validation mapping for 422/409/429/500/network paths is working; values are retained and success state is not shown on failures.
backend/server.py remains very large and high-coupling; splitting modules would reduce regression risk.
seed_data_creation: Created live UI QA records with qa.aic31.*@example.com for verification (e.g., qa.aic31.livefinal.1790009838@example.com, qa.aic31.mobile.1790009886@example.com). No existing user data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public URL from frontend/.env. Confirmed: query cleanup preserves utm/hash, empty/invalid submit sends no POST, India keyboard selection and +91 autosync, Enter-key submit path, one POST on pending double-click, exact success text 'Success Fully Submitted', admin detail modal includes new fields (country_code, phone_country, calling_code, website, initiativeRole/otherRole, contact permission, budget fields), desktop+mobile screenshots captured under /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter31/. CSV export download triggered from admin UI. FAILURE PATHS were tested with PLAYWRIGHT ROUTE INTERCEPTS (MOCKED network responses for 422/409/429/500/network and retry), while core submit/admin verification used REAL endpoints.
rca of the issue: User-reported issue (URL query leak + missing success + missing backend record) is not reproducible now. Reproduced fixed behavior: submit sends exactly one JSON POST /api/ai-consulting-enquiries (201), URL unchanged, success confirmation and receipt shown, record visible in admin and CSV.
